name: Loose µ-Sample
definition: A set of points E is a loose µ-sample of a surface S if: 1) For all x in S intersected with the Voronoi diagram of E, the ball B(x, µ * lfs(x)) contains a point from E (radius of all surface Delaunay balls is less than µ). 2) The Delaunay triangulation of E restricted to S has vertices on all connected components of S.
